minutes.headline: Board moved to approve the TC Passios conceptual plan and asked for three reduced-space options with costs.
minutes.summary: The Select Board heard the state senator's update on bond bill earmarks, public comment on dumping at clothing bins, and an architect's conceptual design for moving town offices and school central offices into the TC Passios building. Members disagreed over offering only one plan, school land needs and student safety. A motion to offer more than one plan was opposed; a motion to approve the conceptual plan with three options was moved and put to a voice vote.

what_happened.line: The Select Board moved to approve the TC Passios conceptual plan and ask for options that remove unassigned space, records space and the back wing; the vote was by voice and not audible.
A motion to offer the town more than one conceptual town hall plan was opposed in discussion, and the minutes record no audible result.
An architect presented a conceptual design for moving town offices and school central offices into the TC Passios building.
The state senator said earmarks for Turkey Hill asbestos and lead removal are in the fiscal 19 budget, and described bond bill earmarks for town projects.
The board said an October workshop is planned on liquor license regulations and other policies.

why_it_matters: The Passios plan decides where town and school offices go and what the town budget, mostly taxes, may be asked to pay for building work, so the options and costs shaped from here bear on future tax bills.
Bond bill earmarks for the town hall ramp, DPW, library and other projects are state money that could reduce what the town budget has to cover for those buildings.
watch_next: The three reduced-space options for TC Passios, with costs, requested by the board.
